I signed up for Harlo Labs and was given 25,000 bolts. I then answered a few questions which gave me additional bolts.
When I went to place an order I seen I had only 7,000 bolts. Can you tell me why there's less than expected?
Handed to the team · Harlo Labs bolt balances are not visible from the store side, so I cannot explai

Larry, the bolts sit on the Harlo Labs side, not the store, so I can't see your balance or what came off it from here. I won't guess at a number that's about your rewards.

I've put it to the team and someone will jump into this chat shortly. If you step away, the answer comes to your email.

If it helps them trace it, did you spend any bolts on anything before you saw 7,000?

Good, that's clean then, nothing spent on your side. I've added that to what the team has.

They're on now and will come into this chat with the answer. Nothing else needed from you in the meantime.
Thank you, and grats on getting emails linked. Nice. :)
